title: Rebuild From Clean
space: the student's own pod, `{user}`'s branch a, reached only with the account's own pod password
goal: Finish the whole core path on your own pod: labs 0 to 4, 6 and 8 each passing `dojo netlab check`, with lab 8 as the rebuild from clean (reset branch a, one `site.yml`, a second run that changes nothing) and your manual and automated branches agreeing. Then run `dojo check capstone`.
seed: No seed: the pod is the seed.
verify_text: The service asks the netlab checker, from outside your terminal, whether it last saw labs 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 pass on your own pod (lab 8 includes the manual-versus-automated branch comparison). Run `dojo netlab check N` for any lab it names, then `dojo check capstone` again.
hints: `dojo check capstone` names the labs the checker has not seen pass yet.
It reads the checker's latest result for each lab, so re-run `dojo netlab check N` for the one it names.
answer: Run `dojo netlab check 0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `6` and `8` until each passes (lab 8 after `ansible-playbook reset_fw.yml -e branch=a`, then your `site.yml` twice, the second run reporting changed=0), then `dojo check capstone`.
isolation: Each student's pod is theirs alone, and the proof is the checker's record for that pod; the verb takes the pod from the checking student's name, never from an argument.
